parameters.content:
## Instagram FREE v10
Same sheet and credentials. Manual AUTO or scheduled AUTO every 30 minutes. CHECK is read-only. Disable v9 before enabling this workflow. Do not overlap manual and scheduled runs. Batch max 5; only NEW/READY are publish approval.

## Recovery
One explicit immediate Cloudinary retry for transient errors; up to 3 queue attempts with cooldown. Stable Cloudinary ID per source; old v9 random assets may already exist. Instagram calls never automatically retried. VERIFY_MANUALLY / PROCESSING require inspection.
